Tamatar Ki Subzi 
indian side dish 

SAVE THIS REEL TO MAKE THIS RECIPE SOON! 

C: 18 | F: 5 | P: 4
Calories: 132 per serving 
Makes 3 servings

Ingredients: 
1 - 2 tsp oil 
1 tsp mustard seeds
1/4 tsp jeera ( optional ) 
1 onion, finely chopped
1 tsp ginger garlic paste
3 green chillies, finely chopped ( adjust as per spice preference )
6 tomatoes, finely chopped ( optional: my mother recommends you can remove the skin of the tomatoes too if you want, i dont bother but she says so so i mention it here lol ) 
1 tsp red chilli powder + 1/2 tsp haldi powder + 1 tsp coriander powder + 1/2 tsp garam masala
salt to taste
large handful chopped coriander

Method 
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds, mustard seeds and let them splutter
Add finely chopped onions and green chilies along with ginger garlic paste. Sauté until the onions turn translucent.
Add turmeric powder, red chili powder, and coriander powder. Mix well and sauté for a minute 
Now, add the finely chopped tomatoes and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook the tomatoes until they become soft and start to break down. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking. If you feel the tomatoes sticking, add a few tbsps of water. 
Add garam masala and adjust the salt according to your taste. Mix well
Cook the tamatar ki subzi for a few more minutes, stirring to avoid burning
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves

Serve hot with steamed rice or roti with dal. i personally love serving this with steamed rice and dahi!!
